title: Cokret ICE Config Response
description: Response shape for the WebRTC media service ICE config endpoint. Used by ck.profile.webrtc_media.v1; see crypto-media/webrtc-signaling.md §4.

realm_id.description: Echo of the request Realm id. Bound into the signature to prevent cross-Realm replay.

call_id.description: Echo of the request call id. Bound into the signature to prevent cross-call replay.

actor_id.description: Actor that may use this ICE configuration. Bound into the signature.

device_id.description: Device that may use this ICE configuration. Bound into the signature.

ice_servers.description: STUN / TURN server entries the client may use during this call.

ttl_seconds.description: Validity window for the issued credentials in seconds. Clients MUST refresh before this expires; servers SHOULD pick a value <= 1 hour for normal calls.

refresh_lead_seconds.description: Minimum lead time before ttl expiry at which the client SHOULD initiate refresh. refresh_lead_seconds MUST be strictly less than ttl_seconds (servers MUST NOT issue refresh_lead_seconds >= ttl_seconds, otherwise the client would judge the credential stale at issuance and storm refresh). Defaults SHOULD be ttl_seconds / 4. The recommended floor (60s) applies only when ttl_seconds is large enough that floor < ttl_seconds still holds; for small ttl (e.g. the 60s minimum) the server MUST shrink refresh_lead_seconds below ttl_seconds (see webrtc-signaling.md §4.2). Required so all clients refresh at consistent cadence and servers can plan secret rotation grace windows.

issued_at.description: Server-issued timestamp (RFC 3339 UTC). Bound into the ICE config signature.

issued_at_bucket.description: Coarse UTC bucket start used for TURN pseudonym derivation. MUST equal floor(issued_at / bucket_seconds) * bucket_seconds. Bound into the signature so TURN usernames cannot be correlated across buckets by rewriting metadata.

bucket_seconds.description: TURN pseudonym bucket size in seconds. v1 fixes the default and interoperable value at 300s; clients SHOULD refresh before crossing the next bucket.

expires_at.description: Convenience field equal to issued_at + ttl_seconds. MUST match within signature validation.

force_turn.description: When true, clients MUST disable host/srflx ICE candidates and only relay through TURN. Used by high-privacy Realms to prevent IP leakage.

next_retry_at.description: Set when the response is a soft failure (e.g. turn_credential_expired). Clients MUST NOT retry before this time.

signature.description: Detached signature by the media service DID over the canonical bytes of this response (excluding `signature`).

urls.description: STUN/TURN server URL(s). Schemes: stun:, stuns:, turn:, turns:.

username.description: TURN ephemeral credential username. v1: <expiry-unix>:<per-call-pseudonym>. MUST NOT contain principal DID, handle, email, or any cross-call stable identifier.

credential.description: TURN ephemeral credential password (HMAC-SHA256 of username with per-tenant turn shared secret in REST-style).

kid.description: Verification method id, typically <media_service_did>#<key-id>. Bare DID is accepted (resolves to the controller's current key); DID URLs with key fragment are RECOMMENDED. Pattern normalized to canonical DID form; the previous `(#.+)?$` was redundant under greedy `[^\s]+`.

sig.description: base64url-encoded detached signature over canonical response bytes.
